title: Get Up With It
desc_lfm_album: Get Up With It is a double album by American jazz trumpeter Miles Davis, released in 1974 on Columbia Records. It is a dense and sprawling work primarily composed of recordings from 1970 to 1974, showcasing Davis's evolving electric jazz fusion sound and his deepening exploration of funk, rock, and avant-garde elements. The album is notable for its extended track lengths, its incorporation of diverse musical textures, and its status as a bridge between the more explicitly rock-influenced *On the Corner* and the introspective *Agharta* and *Pangaea*. title: On the Corner
desc_lfm_album: Miles Davis' On the Corner, released on October 11, 1972, is one of the most polarizing and innovative albums in the history of jazz and beyond. It marked a significant departure from traditional jazz forms, embracing a fusion of funk, rock, avant-garde, and electronic influences. Davis created On the Corner with the intention of appealing to a younger African-American audience that had shifted its attention from jazz to funk and rock.
